requirements.note: Newest-first feed with avatar, author, handle, relative time (updates live), full text, full-width rounded images at their aspect ratio, and carousels of titled cards that run to the screen edge with a '9 moments / Swipe to explore' footer.
Heart toggles liked/unliked and the count (872↔873), filled red when liked; reply count shown.
Tapping a post pushes a 'Post' screen with a larger image (382 pt wide). Tapping an image in the feed, detail or a carousel card opens a black full-screen viewer; swipe down dismisses it.
Pull to refresh shows a system spinner and adds three made-up posts (with images) at the top; the post count goes from 401 to 404.
Compose sheet with Cancel and Post; Post is disabled until text is entered, and the new post appears at the top.
Like, composed post and refreshed posts all survive relaunch.

bugs: VoiceOver label reads '1 minutes ago' (bad plural).
tells: Custom fixed header (serif 'Feed *' wordmark, tagline, big round green compose button) instead of a navigation bar with a large title; it never collapses and takes about 180 pt of every screen.
Branded cream/green palette and a serif filler line ('A moment worth sharing.') on the detail screen read more like a styled web or brand app than a stock iOS one.
Feed rows are buttons with a separate '↗' open-post button, rather than plain tappable cells.
At the largest text size the avatars stay tiny and sit off-axis from the huge names, the '· 407 posts' line wraps awkwardly, and the '↗' glyph does not scale.
The full-screen viewer hides the status bar and has a home-made circular close button.
A.scroll: Smooth with no blank rows or pop-in; images are already there when flung into view, and the scroll position is kept after going to a post and back. The fixed header leaves less room for content, and flings felt slightly short.

requirements.note: Newest-first feed: author, handle · relative time, full text, full-width rounded images at their aspect ratio, and paging carousels of image cards with titles.
Like is exposed as a switch; toggles liked and count (872↔873) with a red filled heart; reply count shown.
Tapping a post pushes a 'Post' screen with the image edge to edge (402 pt). Tapping an image or card opens a black full-screen viewer; swipe down dismisses it.
Pull to refresh adds three made-up posts at the top (text only, newest first); there is also a refresh button in the nav bar.
Compose sheet with Cancel and a prominent Post that is disabled until text is entered; the post appears at the top.
Like, composed post and refreshed posts all survive relaunch.

bugs: Relative times are frozen: refreshed and composed posts say 'Just now' indefinitely, and older posts keep their original '16m ago'.
tells: Carousel is clipped to the content margins instead of running to the screen edge, so the next card is cut off at 16 pt from the edge.
Refreshed posts never have images, so they look plainer than the seed data.
Filler footer text ('You're all caught up on this post.') on the detail screen.
B.scroll: Feels like a native list: the large title collapses into an inline title over a scroll-edge blur, flings are long and smooth with no blank rows, carousels page card by card, and the scroll position is kept after going to a post and back.

why: Both meet every requirement and keep their state across relaunch. B looks and behaves like a stock iOS 27 app (native nav bar with a collapsing large title, Liquid Glass toolbar buttons, system sheet, clean scaling at large text). A is a polished, branded design but a custom fixed header and some layout issues at large text give it away.
